name: crescent-finance-ops
description: Comprehensive financial reporting for the Crescent Arts Collective Finance Ops API covering three business modules. Finance module for branch P&L, income statements, period-over-period comparisons, regional aggregation, and branch ranking. Compensation module for current-year ensemble pay summaries by quarter and pay type, plus multi-year board forecasts driven by scenario growth rates. Payroll module for weekly theatre production payroll with per-musician service pay, premium rules, vacation, guarantee/substitute adjustments, and CBA conflict-flag detection. Use when a task provides a Crescent Finance Ops base URL and asks for any branch close package, ensemble compensation summary, compensation forecast, regional management report, or weekly payroll review. Also use when the task references payloads/environment_access.json pointing to Crescent endpoints, or describes a request memo with a target branch, ensemble, production, or scenario for this API.
